These are lower-value cards but popular with younger collectors and Groot fans. The animated style makes them visually distinct from other MCU cards.',
  keyCards = '- **2023 Upper Deck I Am Groot Baby Groot Base** — Cute animated cards, $2-5\n- **2023 Upper Deck Guardians Groot Variant** — Crossover with GotG sets, $3-8',
  content = '## Baby Groot''s Solo Adventures\n\nI Am Groot delivers exactly what it promises — short, sweet animated adventures featuring everyone''s favorite tiny tree. They are designed as quick, fun animated shorts."},{"question":"When do the I Am Groot shorts take place?","answer":"The shorts take place between Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 1 and Vol. 2, during Baby Groot''s early adventures."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'i-am-groot-season-1-2022';

UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'James Gunn',
  `cast` = 'Chris Pratt as Peter Quill / Star-Lord, Dave Bautista as Drax, Pom Klementieff as Mantis, Kevin Bacon as Himself, Vin Diesel as Groot (voice), Bradley Cooper as Rocket (voice)',
  tagline = 'The greatest gift in the galaxy. James Gunn''s heartwarming holiday farewell to the Guardians.',
  description = 'The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special follows Mantis and Drax as they travel to Earth to kidnap Kevin Bacon as a Christmas present for Peter Quill, in a hilarious and heartwarming holiday adventure.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/gotg-holiday-special-featured-Dn3L2VjpjfVBxoHCxBTVqN.webp',
  episodeCount = 1, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 92, rtAudienceScore = 87, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Holiday Special Cards: Festive Guardians Collectibles\n\nThe Holiday Special cards are fun seasonal collectibles featuring the Guardians in Christmas settings. Kevin Bacon cards are novelty items that collectors love. The special''s reveal that Mantis is Peter''s sister adds emotional weight to Mantis cards from this era.',
  keyCards = '- **2023 Upper Deck GotG Holiday Special Kevin Bacon** — Novelty celebrity card, $5-15\n- **2023 Upper Deck GotG Holiday Mantis/Drax** — Buddy comedy duo card, $3-10\n- **2023 Upper Deck GotG Holiday Guardians Group** — Festive team card, $3-8',
  content = '## The Perfect Holiday Special\n\nJames Gunn delivered exactly what fans wanted — a warm, funny, slightly absurd holiday special that captured everything people love about the Guardians. Mantis and Drax kidnapping Kevin Bacon is the kind of premise only Guardians could pull off, and it works beautifully.\n\n## Kevin Bacon Plays Himself\n\nKevin Bacon gamely playing a version of himself who gets kidnapped by aliens is comedy gold. The meta-humor of the Guardians'' Kevin Bacon obsession (established in the first film) paying off with the actual actor was deeply satisfying.\n\n## Mantis''s Secret\n\nThe special revealed that Mantis is Peter Quill''s half-sister — they share Ego as a father. This emotional revelation, delivered in a holiday context, added genuine heart to what could have been pure comedy.\n\n## Fun Facts\n\n- James Gunn wrote and directed this between finishing Vol. 3 and starting DC Studios\n- Kevin Bacon was genuinely excited to be part of the MCU\n- The special is considered required viewing before Guardians Vol. 3\n- The songs were performed by the Old 97s, a real band\n- It was filmed on the same sets as Guardians Vol. 3',
  metaDescription = 'Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special (2022) guide — Kevin Bacon kidnapping, Mantis reveal, holiday fun, and trading card values.',
  keywords = 'guardians galaxy holiday special, kevin bacon, mantis, drax, james gunn, disney plus marvel, christmas, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Guardians Holiday Special cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is the Holiday Special required viewing before Vol. 3?","answer":"It is recommended viewing as it establishes the Guardians'' current status, reveals Mantis as Peter''s sister, and shows how they acquired Knowhere as their base."},{"question":"Does Kevin Bacon actually appear?","answer":"Yes, Kevin Bacon plays himself in the special, getting kidnapped by Mantis and Drax as a Christmas gift for Star-Lord."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'the-guardians-of-the-galaxy-holiday-special-2022'
